Name: Managed Runtime project Id
Used in: Configure Your Environment File; Deploy Bundle to Managed Runtime
Sourced from: The Project Id (not name) in the Managed Runtime

Name: Managed Runtime target
Used in: Configure Your Environment File; Deploy Bundle to Managed Runtime
Sourced from: Business Manager post scaffolding or Managed Runtime

Name: Managed Runtime deployment URL
Used in: Deploy Bundle to Managed Runtime; Access Deployed Storefront
Sourced from: Business Manager post scaffolding in Administration → Sites → Storefronts → MarketStreet → Environments → eCDN → Expand Routing Rule

Name: Account Manager username
Used in: Log in to the Managed Runtime; Scaffold the Storefront Next Project
Sourced from: Username (email address) for Account Manager

Name: Account Manager password (Secret)
Used in: Log in to the Managed Runtime; Scaffold the Storefront Next Project
Sourced from: Password for Account Manager. Keep it private.

Name: WebDAV access key (Secret)
Used in: Scaffold the Storefront Next Project
Sourced from: The WebDAV access key for your sandbox user. Keep it private.

Name: SLAS client Id
Used in: Configure Your Environment File; Run Locally and Verify
Sourced from: .csv file from Option A or SLAS Admin tool

Name: SLAS client secret (Secret)
Used in: Configure Your Environment File; Run Locally and Verify
Sourced from: .csv file from Option A or SLAS Admin tool - must be collected on creation if using SLAS Admin

Name: SLAS private client enabled
Used in: Configure Your Environment File
Sourced from: Set this to true

Name: Site Id
Used in: Configure Your Environment File; Run Locally and Verify
Sourced from: Business Manager → Administration → Sites → Manage Sites

Name: Commerce API organization Id
Used in: Configure Your Environment File
Sourced from: Business Manager: Administration → Site Development → Salesforce Commerce API Settings

Name: Commerce API short code
Used in: Configure Your Environment File
Sourced from: Business Manager: Administration → Site Development → Salesforce Commerce API Settings

Name: Sandbox host name
Used in: Scaffold the Storefront Next Project; Configure Your Environment File
Sourced from: The initial part of your sandbox URL between the protocol and path is the hostname.

Name: Realm
Used in: Scaffold the Storefront Next Project; Configure Your Environment File
Sourced from: The initial part of your sandbox URL between the protocol and the first dash (-) before the first dot (.) in the hostname.

Name: Instance
Used in: Scaffold the Storefront Next Project; Configure Your Environment File
Sourced from: The initial part of your sandbox URL between the protocol and after the first dash (-) before the first dot (.) in the hostname. In sandboxes. Typically numeric.

Name: Subdomain
Used in: Scaffold the Storefront Next Project; Configure Your Environment File
Sourced from: Concatenation of B2C_realm, a single dash and B2C_instance. The initial part of your B2C hostname before the first dot (.)

Name: Tenant
Used in: Scaffold the Storefront Next Project; Configure Your Environment File
Sourced from: The B2C_subdomain with underscore replacing dash

Name: Org username
Used in: CLI commands (--target-org); Verify Your Account
Sourced from: Verify Your Account Email from support. This looks like an email address, but it isn’t although there’s an email backing it.

Name: Org Id
Used in: Salesforce org setup; Agentforce Guided Shopping activities
Sourced from: Setup → Company Information or Workshop Email with subject: Salesforce Org Environment Details

Name: Service channel Id
Used in: Agentforce Guided Shopping activities
Sourced from: Query Salesforce org via script (upcoming activity)

Name: Queue Id
Used in: Agentforce Guided Shopping activities
Sourced from: Query Salesforce org via script (upcoming activity)

Name: Copilot Id
Used in: Agentforce Guided Shopping activities
Sourced from: Query Salesforce org via script (upcoming activity)
